snippet.title: Power Drill Massacre - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: https://puppetcombo.itch.io/pdm

Power Drill Massacre is a throwback to PS1 survival horror, 80's slasher flicks, and the golden age of VHS home video. For Windows & Mac

Now in early access on itch io: https://puppetcombo.itch.io/pdm

Thanks to Andrei Saar for the great voice-over (https://soundcloud.com/andreisaarvoice)

CREDITS

TITLE CARD IMAGES
'May and a power drill' by Steve Pomeroy (CC BY-SA 2.0)
Drill Bit by Jordanhill School D&T Dept (CC BY 2.0)
'part of the earth' by Jenavieve (CC BY-SA 2.0)
'Screwtop spiral' by Alexmetcalfe (CC BY-SA 3.0)
'They're creepy and they're kooky' by frankieleon (CC BY 2.0)
'Birds Flying Into Sunset' by Lars Kasper (CC BY 2.0)
'Lightning Storm 2' by Dean Souglass (CC BY 2.0)

SOUNDS

'Breathing' by ejgvibes (CC BY 3.0)
